# phash raw fixture provenance

The upstream `modhash` kit exercised its pHash vectors through PNG
fixtures generated by `lab/phash_oracle.py` (Python 3 stdlib only). This
crate does not decode PNG, so each fixture is committed as the
**decoded pixel matrix** the oracle hashed: flat, row-major,
channel-interleaved samples, **little-endian** for 16-bit, one file per
vector, layout recorded in `src/reference.rs` (`RawVector::layout`).

Extraction: the kit's own `lab/phash_oracle.py` was executed against the
upstream checkout; its oracle pixel matrices (`IMAGES` entries — the
expanded pixels for the palette+tRNS file, the de-interlaced pixels for
the Adam7 file) were dumped verbatim. The expected pHash values are the
oracle's committed output, unchanged; `tests/phash_vectors.rs` pins them
independently of `reference.json`.

`base_444.raw` is byte-identical to the kit's
`modhash-jpeg/tests/fixtures/base_444.raw` (the byte-exact decode of the
kit's `base_444.jpg` reference).
